brief: a 30 second explainer for our recipe app's new feature that plans meals for the week
concept: Sunday night's 'what's for dinner all week' becomes a single tap.
plan_outline: 1. Generated MCU · eye · static · kitchen at night · a tired mother staring into an open fridge (3 s, the hook)
2. Page · 'Every Sunday, the same question.' (3 s)
3. Page · a phone outline with the feature's three steps animating in (8 s; the real UI composited by the brand)
4. Generated MS · eye · track · same kitchen, daytime · the family cooking together, laughing (4 s)
5. Page · logo and 'Plan the week in one tap' (3 s)
why: The human problem first, the feature second; type pages explain, generated shots make you feel it.
The app's interface is never generated (garbled UI); an outline with animated steps stands in.
